Context: 5. Monthly subscription and amount of Insurance Cover:-

16. No withdrawals /loans/ advances are permissible out of the Insurance/ Savings Fund. Accumulated benefits are payable only on the cessation of membership from the Scheme on account of death, retirement, resignation, etc. - Paras. 13.1, 12.1 and 12.2.
